findings.evidenceJa: 人知れず滅びる定めとなった
findings.governingReading: 滅びる定め describes a future destiny after ability had declined while knowledge remained.
findings.explanation: Destined obscure extinction becomes an extinction already met.

findings.highlight: never had any doubts that his sister would be cast off and raised separately.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分と切り離されて育てられている事に疑問をもたなかった
findings.governingReading: He did not question why she was being raised separately from him, given one-heir teaching.
findings.explanation: Not questioning existing separate upbringing becomes certainty of future casting-off.

findings.highlight: that he'd constructed in his head
findings.evidenceJa: 彼を形成していたもの
findings.governingReading: The revelation overturns both what Shinji believed and what had shaped him.
findings.explanation: What shaped Shinji becomes something he constructed in his head. The family revelation still overturns his self-image, but the sentence shifts emphasis toward his own mental construction.

findings.highlight: She didn't necessarily say it out loud
findings.governingReading: 口にこそ出さないが explicitly distinguishes apologies read in her conduct from the actual speech at20.
findings.explanation: Unspoken attributed apologies become said sorry and only not necessarily aloud.

findings.highlight: he would have lost his dignity
findings.evidenceJa: 兄の尊厳も捨てられた
findings.governingReading: 兄の尊厳も捨てられた says ignoring him would allow him to abandon the brother-role dignity and its hope.
findings.explanation: Being able to discard brotherly dignity becomes losing dignity.

findings.highlight: It won't change the fact that her name is the one on the door.
findings.evidenceJa: ここは玄関にかけられた、間桐桜という表札と変わらない
findings.governingReading: ここは……表札と変わらない compares room to the externally displayed name, explaining its merely formal role.
findings.explanation: The empty room being equivalent to a facade nameplate becomes unchanged ownership of the door name.

findings.governingReading: 掻き毟る is violent clawing/tearing at the fabric.
findings.explanation: Scratching or tearing at sheets becomes tearing them off.

findings.highlight: Argh, and you're still gonna apologize to me!
findings.evidenceJa: 「ああ、それなのに謝るんだよなおまえは
findings.governingReading: The entire demand is quoted Shinji speech.
findings.explanation: A complete spoken tirade loses dialogue delimiters.

findings.highlight: she started to think like a human being
findings.evidenceJa: 人並みに物を考え言うようになった
findings.governingReading: 物を考え言う explicitly gives both thinking and saying things as recovery after meeting Shirou.
findings.explanation: Recovered ordinary thought and speech retain only thought.

findings.evidenceJa: 謹慎を申し付けている
findings.governingReading: 謹慎を申し付けている is an imposed disciplinary restriction.
findings.explanation: An order of confinement or disciplinary restriction becomes a warning to restrain himself.
